start.npc: "The church sees all who enter its halls. What brings you before the faith?"

options.text: I wish to prove my devotion. What would you have me do?
I've returned regarding the offering you asked for.

blessing.npc: "Blessings be with you, come back when you're willing to give more than words."

priest_quest.npc: "The church always needs the faithful to serve. {quest_description} Do this, and your name will be known among us."

turn_in.npc: "Have you brought what was asked for {quest_label}?"

options.text: Not yet. I am still gathering.

complete.npc: "You have served well. The church does not forget its own. Your standing grows."

not_done.npc: "Then do not delay. The church still waits for its due. {quest_description}"

accepted.npc: "Then go. The church will know of your devotion."

declined.npc: "Doubt is a heavy burden. Return when your faith is ready."
